metadata.title: Programme for Government accountability tracker
metadata.baseline_document: Programme for Government 2025 — Securing Ireland's Future (162-page published PDF)
metadata.status_note: Expanded extraction: 54 individually identified commitment records across core policy areas. This is a substantial structured extraction of measurable, time-bound and major service commitments, not yet a literal transcription of every bullet in all 162 pages. Wording and printed page references are checked against the published PDF where stated. New rows remain not_verifiable until delivery evidence is reconciled.
next_research_priorities: Continue extracting remaining programme actions, including fisheries, arts/culture, sport, media, local democracy, public-sector reform, shared island and tourism commitments.
Reconcile each commitment with current department and agency delivery datasets; update status only where evidence directly measures the pledge.
Add exact PDF page and direct departmental delivery source for every remaining action.
metadata.extraction_source_note: Original 162-page PDF hosted by the HRB National Drugs Library, which reproduces the Department of the Taoiseach publication. Cross-check: Department of the Taoiseach publication page.

status_definitions.in_progress: A relevant implementation action or measurable output is evidenced; this does not mean the final target is on track.
status_definitions.not_verifiable: Available sources do not establish a reliable delivery status against the exact commitment.
status_definitions.delivered: The specified output is complete; outcome effectiveness must still be assessed separately.
status_definitions.delayed: A published milestone or deadline has been missed, supported by evidence.
status_definitions.revised: The Government has formally changed the commitment or target.

starter_rows.commitment_theme: Deliver 300,000 new homes by the end of 2030.

starter_rows.responsible_department: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
starter_rows.responsible_minister: Verify current officeholder when publishing each update
